definitions.gloss: Western calendar, Christian Era, Common Era
definitions.explanation: The calendar system based on years counted from the traditional birth year of Jesus Christ; the Gregorian calendar dating system.

examples.japanese: {西暦|せいれき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write it in the Western calendar.

notes:
Japan uses two calendar systems: {西暦|せいれき} (Western/Gregorian calendar) and ⟦{和暦|われき}→和暦：28485_wareki⟧ (Japanese era calendar based on imperial reigns).

CALENDAR SYSTEMS IN JAPAN:
- {西暦|せいれき}: Western calendar (2024, 2025, etc.)
- ⟦{和暦|われき}→和暦：28485_wareki⟧: Japanese era calendar (⟦{令和|れいわ}→令和：11181_reiwa⟧, ⟦{平成|へいせい}→平成：11180_heisei⟧, ⟦{昭和|しょうわ}→昭和：28079_shouwa⟧, etc.)

USAGE:
- International contexts, business, younger generations often prefer {西暦|せいれき}
- Government documents, traditional contexts often use ⟦{和暦|われき}→和暦：28485_wareki⟧
- Many forms accept either

ABBREVIATIONS:
- A.D. / C.E. correspond to {西暦|せいれき} (though B.C./B.C.E. would be ⟦{紀元前|きげんぜん}→紀元前：13831_kigenzen⟧)
